provider_receipt.summary: Read-only review completed. The parent receipt consistently authenticates the declared tracked clean-tree check, and its recorded tool evidence contains no mutating action; however, `git diff --exit-code HEAD --` alone cannot detect untracked outputs and provides no implementation or behavioral verification. Named implementation defects: `MemoryStore::store` only serializes and discards each record, so scanning does not provide the documented persistent Mnemosyne integration; `NoteFrontmatter` is incompatible with the active ingestion contract, notably requiring numeric confidence and omitting contract, authority, privacy, ownership, and review metadata; vault traversal silently discards WalkDir errors, allowing incomplete scans to appear successful; wikilink resolution does not constrain resolved paths to the vault and can recognize existing paths outside it through absolute or parent-relative links; and the `backlinks` field contains outgoing links rather than backlinks. Existing tests cover only legacy frontmatter, one same-directory link, and a missing path, so they do not address these defects. No files were modified or created during this review.
